## About Cunning Juniper
This is a small, basic Minecraft mod designed for common players. 
  You!can be built from new blocks. Without our blocks, buildings will become more complex and others will not be possible! Because if you look, Minecraft has almost no yellow blocks with derivatives such as stairs, slabs, and walls. But with this mod you can use this beautiful yellow blocks.
  ![Beautiful golden mud](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/95060abc00a8e6215f19a8f6b68e2b2f4f938d07_0.webp)

And Standard **Minecraft** doesn't offer enough ways to troll your friends. But with the new items, it's easier.
![New items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e5057b8bb087187291d5cc95b75a0296a517b25_0.webp)
### About me
   This is my first and completely one-off.
